answer: The slowest session spent 998.1s in turns. Main-thread model time was 956.3s, tool execution 6.5s and permission waits 35.7s. 0 requests needed retries and 0 spans ended in error. Span sums overlap when tools run in parallel, so open a turn to see the exact split.
sql:
WITH turns AS (SELECT session_id, sum(duration_ms) AS turn_ms FROM spans WHERE name='claude_code.interaction' GROUP BY 1),
s AS (SELECT session_id FROM turns ORDER BY turn_ms DESC LIMIT 1)
SELECT t.session_id, round(t.turn_ms/1000,1) AS turn_s,
  round(sum(sp.duration_ms) FILTER (WHERE sp.name='claude_code.llm_request' AND a(sp.attrs,'agent_id') IS NULL)/1000,1) AS model_s,
  round(sum(sp.duration_ms) FILTER (WHERE sp.name='claude_code.tool.execution')/1000,1) AS tool_exec_s,
  round(sum(sp.duration_ms) FILTER (WHERE sp.name='claude_code.tool.blocked_on_user')/1000,1) AS permission_wait_s,
  count(*) FILTER (WHERE sp.name='claude_code.llm_request' AND n(sp.attrs,'attempt') > 1) AS retried_requests,
  count(*) FILTER (WHERE sp.is_error) AS error_spans
FROM turns t JOIN spans sp ON sp.session_id=t.session_id WHERE t.session_id IN (SELECT session_id FROM s)
GROUP BY t.session_id, t.turn_ms
